recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the FHIR-23062 breadcrumb/title correction in the current active conversion page while avoiding inactive legacy files; any cleanup of source/r3maps.html should be considered separately only if that page returns to the build.
issue_request: FHIR-23062 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction requesting that resource model R4 Conversion tab breadcrumb text say R3/R4 Conversions instead of R2/R3 Conversions.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by commit 11e3a4e14ee4eab1e5ce8a7bf55d6afcbd74b922, referenced from the Jira comment as GH#11e3a4e14e, which changed the old Publisher.java generated resource title from res-R2/R3 Conversions to res-R3/R4 Conversions. That in-tree publisher source was later removed when the build moved to the Gradle/kindling publisher dependency.
additional_context: Current FHIR source now publishes R4/R5 conversion pages. The resource-specific template tools/templates/template-version-maps.html already says Resource <%title%> - R4/R5 Conversions, but active source/r4maps.html was still copied with settitle Differences from DSTU Release 3 even though publish.ini, source/hierarchy.xml, page links, and page content identify it as the Release 4/5 transform page. Legacy source/r3maps.html still has older R2/R3 wording but is not active in publish.ini or hierarchy.xml, so it was not edited.
reconciliation: Changed only source/r4maps.html line 3 to set the page title to Transforms between Release 4 and Release 5. No resource template change was needed because the current resource conversion template is already correct for R4/R5.
source_changes: source/r4maps.html: changed the settitle from Differences from DSTU Release 3 to Transforms between Release 4 and Release 5.
